name: Solin
summary: Solin pairs a pure matte silver travertine top with a bronze brushed stainless steel mirror frame and a 5 mm silver mirror illuminated by a clean LED strip. Brass metallic legs and drawer fronts add warmth, while melamine-lined drawers keep the interior practical. The mirror’s matte black back finishes the piece with a sharp, modern contrast. Top with silver travertine marble in pure matt, the mirror frame stainless steel plating in bronze brushed. 5MM silver mirror with led light strip. The legs and drawer front panel paint in brass metallic, drawer inner with melamine. mirror back in matt black color 145x45x76
